title: Mixed Event — Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back — Episode1 Another Senpai

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back
meta.Event Outline: It's almost time for the Miya Girls choir recital. Honami is selected as the coordinator for her class, but it's hard to coordinate when everyone's opinions are split right down the middle! What is kindness? Stuck between a rock and a hard place, Honami gives her answer...!

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're going to practice together after school today, so I need to remember to bring the sheet music!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's always so strict with us...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But now that we're finally starting to play more like a band, I have to do my part and practice hard too!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hooona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep! Saki?!
You startled me...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, didn't I tell you to stop throwing yourself at other people like that? You might end up hurting them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Hona's so soft and huggable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's not a good reason at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm soft... Oh no...
Did I go overboard with apple pies?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami. For today's practice, I need to check something for the part I couldn't get right the other day. Can you help?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah! The part Shiho was telling us about?
I wanna practice that part too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And hopefully, Shiho will finally commend us today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's all work toward that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And also, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, how are things with your classmates lately...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thanks, Ichika...
For being concerned about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Everything is fine.
We're getting along great.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But let us know if anything happens again, okay? We'll set things straight for you again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you. Both of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, we should head back to class soon.
See you again after school, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, there she is!
Honami, are you free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After school?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: We're planning to go get some pancakes together. You wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for inviting me, but I can't, sorry. I already have something I need to do after school today, so I won't be able to join you.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Where are you going after school?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have band practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh yeah! That's right!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Well, there's always next time.
Good luck with practice, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I really have to thank Ichika and the others for how honest I can be with my classmates now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank you, everyone.)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait... Are Miku and Luka not here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're right. That's unusual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're probably around here somewhere, right? The last time this happened, we bumped into Luka on the rooftop, remember?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyways, shall we get ready then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're gonna nail those songs today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so eager to go, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She's been doing really well recently too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And the choir recital is soon too, right?
That's been fueling her enthusiasm as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The choir recital...
Right. I'd forgotten all about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's one set piece and one of our choice, if I remember correctly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Sounds like a pain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! It's not a pain! It's gonna be so much fun to sing together with all our classmates!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which means less time for band practice, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, well... Yes, but you know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure we all have our own views of the event... But instead of discussing this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I wonder where Miku and Luka are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little worried. Could something have happened?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm... Why don't we go look for them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Maybe they're just hanging out in another classroom. Let's go look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heeey! Miku! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They're not inside this one either...
Could something actually have happened?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Is that... Someone playing the drums?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's coming from the classroom in the corner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe Miku and Luka are playing there. Let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's this classroom, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello? Miku? Luka?
Huh?
Hey girls, nice of you to drop by. Welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Except that probably sounds a little strange considering I'm the newcomer here.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you the people whose feelings created this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No way... You're...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yup, I'm MEIKO.
Nice to meet you all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! Seriously?!
